correctness.rationale: For period dividing two, the lagging leaves force the full state to alternate between \((a,b)\) and \((b,a)\). Majority constraints become same-color-neighbor conditions on a degree-two bipartite temporal double cover. This graph is one length-double cycle when the ring size is odd and two equal cycles when it is even. A four-state transfer matrix has characteristic polynomial \((\lambda^2-\lambda-1)(\lambda^2-\lambda+1)\), giving the claimed word count, two-step populations, fixed counts and primitive orbit formula. The asymptotics follow from the Perron root. The prior finite symmetric-threshold theorem supplies eventual periods at most two. Independent bitwise enumeration checked all 1,398,080 states across sizes three through ten, plus transfer and word checks. The domain begins at ring size three; finite checks are corroboration only.

value.rationale: An exact classification of all recurrent orbits for a natural infinite graph family with every vertex degree one or three has intrinsic significance for synchronous opinion dynamics. The parity-dependent temporal double-cover decomposition explains the exact factorization and leads to a nontrivial exponential recurrent-state fraction; this is more than reproducing generic period <=2 or evaluating an arbitrary finite table.
